name: Base44 Backend

evidence.nosql: D01: managed NoSQL documents with MongoDB-compatible operators through the Base44 SDK
evidence.backend: C02: managed backend platform; C07: entities, auth, realtime, files and functions
evidence.files: F04: live uploads of 50-100 MB by file type; F05: UploadFile documented
evidence.jobs: J04: workflow recurring schedules at most once per 5 minutes, timezone-aware

line: Build apps with hosted data, auth, files, realtime, and functions.

free.text: 100 integration credits monthly; up to 5 apps

cells.regions: US default; EU, UK, Australia on Business/Enterprise

sql.math: $16 a month equivalent. The 1 GB database fits the first published plan size. Transfer terms are unknown and not included.
The annual Starter subscription stays at $192 a year (a $16 a month equivalent) while data is kept.

files.math: No separate file storage price is published, so the cost of 100 GB is not known.

jobs.math: The Builder plan is $40 a month equivalent. 10K function calls are estimated at about 100 credits. Whether the plan includes them, and whether the workers fit, is uncertain.
